summary: OpenPhoenux supporter, Neo900 project contributor, strong advocate for open-source software and hardware, experienced in GNU/Linux development, Python programming, and mobile technology, critical of mainstream mobile OS privacy practices, based in Europe, engaged in discussions about privacy and security in technology, frequent participant in game jams, interested in niche tech communities, particularly around mobile devices like Neo Freerunner and Nokia N900, critical of corporate control over technology, promotes user freedom and control over devices, has a technical background in software development and hardware tinkering.
